Entries.jodiDistance: Dear @,^I'm sorry I've been so distant lately. It isn't anything you did. I'm just scared, and I need a little time to catch my breath.^Please don't think I've stopped caring. I just don't know how to be brave yet.^   -Jodi[#]A Note from Jodi
Entries.jodiLoveLetter: Dear @,^I'm writing this at the kitchen table, because I'm too shy to say it to your face.^You stayed. Even when I ran, even when I couldn't explain myself. I'm not afraid anymore. I want to be yours, every day, for as long as you'll have me.^Thank you for waiting for me.^   -Your Jodi[#]Jodi's Letter

Entries.spring_Mon4: Mondays. The laundry pile looks at me like it already knows I'm going to lose.$s#$e#Sorry, you didn't come here to hear me complain about socks.
Entries.spring_Wed4: Ow... oh, hi, @. Don't mind me, it's just my back.$s#$b#I spent all morning hauling water and now I'm walking like Grandpa's old rocking chair.$h#$e#Harvey says I should rest. As if the house knows how to clean itself.
Entries.spring_Fri6: Do you ever feel like everyone expects you to be a certain way? Cheerful, helpful, always available?$s#$b#I've been that for so long I'm not sure what's left when I stop.#$e#Anyway. Why am I telling you this?$6
Entries.spring_Thu8: Can I ask you something, @? And please be honest.#$b#Why do you spend time with me? There are so many younger people in town who'd be easier to be around.$s#$e#Sorry. Forget I asked. I'm just not used to someone choosing me.
Entries.spring_Sat4: I tried a new recipe today and burned the whole thing. Sam took one bite and said it was 'interesting'.$s#$e#The worst part is I wasn't even mad. I was just tired.
Entries.summer_Mon4: I asked Sam and Vincent to help with the dishes. Do you know what I got? Two 'in a minute's.$a#$e#I love them. I do. But sometimes I'd like to be more than the person who keeps the house running.
Entries.summer_Tue6: This heat makes my back flare up something awful.$s#$b#I tried stretching like Harvey showed me and I made a noise I'm still embarrassed about.$6#$e#You didn't hear that.
Entries.summer_Fri4: Everyone at the store keeps asking how the boys are doing. Nobody ever asks how I'm doing.#$e#...Not that I'd know what to say.
Entries.summer_Sat8: I caught myself smiling at nothing this morning, and then I felt guilty about it.$s#$b#Isn't that silly? Feeling guilty for being happy?#$e#It's what you do to me, @. I hope you know that.
Entries.fall_Mon4: My to-do list has its own to-do list at this point.#$e#If I ever finish everything, I'll probably faint from the shock.$h
Entries.fall_Wed6: I walked past Abigail and Penny today, laughing like they didn't have a care in the world.$s#$b#I used to laugh like that. I'd like to again.#$e#I just feel like I missed my turn.
Entries.fall_Thu4: Harvey gave me another lecture about my back. 'Lift with your legs, Jodi.' 'Take breaks, Jodi.'$a#$b#I told him when I have a spare minute, I'll gladly take one.$h
Entries.fall_Sat6: I found another gray hair this morning.$s#$b#I counted them, @. I actually counted them.#$e#Do you think I look... old? No, don't answer that. I'm not ready.
Entries.winter_Mon4: Winter is hard on my bones. Getting out of bed every morning feels like negotiating with a stubborn mule.$s#$e#But the snow is pretty, at least.
Entries.winter_Wed6: Some days I feel invisible. Like I'm part of the furniture.$s#$b#And then you walk in and say hello and I remember I'm a person.$l#$e#Thank you for that.
Entries.winter_Sat8: I keep waiting for the moment you realize I'm not worth the trouble.$s#$b#I know that's an awful thing to say. It's just how my head works.#$e#So if you ever change your mind, please tell me. I'd rather know than hope.

Entries.JodiPulledAway: ...Oh. Hello, @.$s#$b#I can't talk today. I need some air. Please understand.
Entries.spring_Mon8: Oh... hello, @. I'm a little busy today.$s#$e#I'll see you around, okay?
Entries.spring_Tue8: I'm not avoiding you. ...I'm avoiding something. I just don't know how to say what.$s
Entries.spring_Fri8: Every time I think I have it figured out, you show up and my thoughts scatter like startled chickens.$6#$b#It scares me, how much I want you to stay.$s
Entries.summer_Mon8: I wrote you a letter and tore it up. Twice.$s#$b#I'm sorry I pulled away. I'm frightened of how fast this is going.#$e#Please be patient with me.
Entries.summer_Wed8: I looked in the mirror this morning and tried to see what you see.$s#$b#I couldn't.#$e#I don't think that's your fault.
Entries.summer_Sat8: If you're here to ask why I've been distant, I don't have a good answer yet.$s#$b#Just... don't give up on me. Please.
Entries.fall_Tue8: My back's been terrible and my head's worse.$s#$b#It's strange. When I'm hurting, you're the first person I think of. And that's the part that frightens me.
Entries.fall_Thu8: I've spent most of my life taking care of other people. Letting someone take care of me feels... wrong, somehow.$s#$e#But I'm trying. Slowly.
Entries.fall_Sat8: I almost came to find you yesterday. I got halfway down the path before I lost my nerve and went back.$6#$e#Isn't that pathetic?
Entries.winter_Tue8: You keep showing up. Even when I'm like this.$s#$b#Nobody's ever done that for me before.$l#$e#I don't know what to do with that.
Entries.winter_Fri8: Part of me wants to run, and part of me wants to run to you.$s#$e#I'm exhausted from running, @.
Entries.spring_Wed10: I think I'm finally ready to stop pretending I don't care.$s#$e#Give me a little more time to say it properly.
Entries.fall_Mon10: You've been so patient with me. More than I deserve, honestly.$s#$b#I'm working on believing I deserve it.
Entries.winter_Wed10: Something is changing in me, @. It's slow, but it's there.$l

Entries.JodiDevoted: I can't stop smiling today. People are staring. I don't care.$l#$e#Thank you for not giving up on me.
Entries.spring_Mon10: Good morning, @! I made too much breakfast on purpose so I'd have a reason to bring you some.$h#$e#...I'm not very subtle, am I?
Entries.spring_Wed10: I used to dread the days. Now I count the hours until I might see you.$l#$b#Is that too much to say out loud? I'm saying it anyway.
Entries.spring_Fri10: My back hurts, my feet hurt, and I couldn't be happier. That's your doing too, you know.$h
Entries.spring_Sat10: Harvey says my back is better. I told him it's because someone makes me stop and sit down.$h#$e#He gave me a look. I think he approves.
Entries.summer_Tue10: I'm not scared of what people say anymore. Let them talk. I've got something worth talking about.$l
Entries.summer_Thu10: I still have bad days, @. My back, my doubts, all of it.$s#$b#But now I know where I want to go when they hit.$l
Entries.summer_Fri10: You looked at me today like I was the only person in the room. Do you know how long it's been since someone did that?$l#$e#Don't stop.
Entries.fall_Mon10: I made a list of everything I'm grateful for. Your name ran out of room on the page.$h
Entries.fall_Wed10: I don't feel old when I'm with you. I feel somewhere between the girl I was and the woman I've become.$l#$e#I like her.
Entries.fall_Fri10: When I think about the person I was a year ago, I want to hug her. Then I want to tell her to be brave.$s#$b#I'm glad I finally listened to myself.
Entries.fall_Sat10: Remember when I used to flinch every time you were nice to me? I'm almost over that.$h#$e#Almost.
Entries.winter_Tue10: I'm warm even when it's snowing. That's your fault.$l#$e#Don't look so smug.
Entries.winter_Thu10: I'd like to grow old with you, @. I know I'm already well on my way, but still.$h
Entries.winter_Fri10: No more running from you. I decided. You're stuck with me.$l

Entries.AcceptGift_(O)72: $action AddConversationTopic JodiDiamond 7#A... a diamond?$u#$b#@, do you have any idea what this is worth?! Why would you give this to me?$9#$b#No one has ever given me anything like this. Not even...$s#$b#...Never mind. I'll keep it, but I need to sit down. My legs are shaking.$l
Entries.JodiDiamond: I haven't stopped thinking about that diamond. I keep taking it out to look at it, then hiding it in case someone sees.$h#$b#Caroline asked why I was so jumpy. I told her I'd seen a mouse.$6#$e#Is it silly to be this happy about a rock? ...It isn't about the rock, you know.

Entries.AcceptGift_(O)72: $action AddConversationTopic JodiDiamond 7#A diamond...?$u#$b#I can't accept this, @. I shouldn't.$s#$b#...Oh, who am I kidding, I'm taking it. But this is exactly what scares me. How am I supposed to deserve something like this?$6
Entries.JodiDiamond: I keep that diamond in my pocket. It sits there, heavy, reminding me that someone sees me.$s#$b#I haven't decided yet whether that's wonderful or terrifying.

Entries.AcceptGift_(O)72: $action AddConversationTopic JodiDiamond 7#A diamond!$u#$b#You spoiled, wonderful person! I told you not to spend your money on me.$h#$b#...But I love it. And I love you for thinking of me. Look how my hands are shaking.$l
Entries.JodiDiamond: Vincent asked about the sparkle on my dresser. I told him it's a present from someone who loves me.$l#$b#He gave me a funny look. Then a big smile.

Changes.LogName: Jodi: marriage dialogue, scared but trying

Entries.JodiPulledAway: ...Oh. Hello, honey.$s#$b#I'm sorry, I need a little air today. It's not you. I swear it's not you.
Entries.JodiDiamond: I keep taking that diamond out of the drawer just to look at it. Then I put it back, so I won't get used to it.$s#$b#It's the nicest thing anyone's ever given me. I'm still working on believing I'm allowed to have it.
Entries.Rainy_Day_0: Be careful out there, honey. I worry more than I let on when it rains.$s
Entries.Rainy_Day_1: I made soup. I hope it's alright. I never know if what I make is good enough.[199 219 236 456 457]
Entries.Rainy_Day_2: My back is stiff from the damp. I'll try to rest, but you know me, I can't sit still when I'm nervous.$s
Entries.Rainy_Day_3: Do you ever wonder if you made a mistake marrying me? ...Forget I said that. It's just the rain talking.$s
Entries.Rainy_Day_4: I told Sam I'm fine. He didn't believe me. I'm not sure I do either.$s
Entries.Rainy_Night_0: You're home. Good. I keep half expecting you won't come back one day.$s#$e#I know that's not fair to you.
Entries.Rainy_Night_1: I waited by the window. I'm sorry, that's clingy of me, isn't it?$6
Entries.Rainy_Night_2: Would you sit with me? You don't have to talk. I just don't want to be alone with my thoughts tonight.$s
Entries.Rainy_Night_3: I made you something warm. It's all I know how to do when I don't know what to say.[395 253 614]
Entries.Rainy_Night_4: The rain is loud, and so is my head. But you're here, so it's a little quieter.
Entries.Indoor_Day_0: I woke up early to make everything nice. I want you to feel like you made a good choice.$s
Entries.Indoor_Day_1: Pancakes. I hope they're okay. I tried really hard on them.[211]
Entries.Indoor_Day_2: I cleaned the same shelf three times. Anxious hands, you know.
Entries.Indoor_Day_3: I almost asked Caroline if I'm a terrible spouse. Then I remembered how embarrassing that would be.$6
Entries.Indoor_Day_4: Is there anything you need from me today? I'd feel better if I could do something right.
Entries.Indoor_Night_0: Welcome home. Do you want to eat first, or...? Sorry, I'm fussing. I fuss when I'm scared.$s
Entries.Indoor_Night_1: I cooked dinner. Please tell me honestly if it's bad.[231 198 200 205 214]
Entries.Indoor_Night_2: My back is killing me tonight. Don't worry, I'm just complaining. Habit.$s#$e#I'm not used to having someone to complain to.
Entries.Indoor_Night_3: Are you tired? I can turn the lights down. Whatever you want, dear.
Entries.Indoor_Night_4: I keep waiting for the day you tell me you've had enough. Silly, right?$s#$e#Please don't actually say it.
Entries.Outdoor_0: It's beautiful out here. I keep waiting for the catch.
Entries.Outdoor_1: The fresh air helps my head. My back, not so much, but I'm managing.
Entries.Outdoor_2: I'm not much help out here, am I? I'm sorry. I'll try harder tomorrow.$s
Entries.Outdoor_3: Sometimes I walk around the farm just to remind myself it's real. That I live here. With you.
Entries.Outdoor_4: Even the animals look happier than I feel. ...Sorry. That was dramatic.$6
Entries.Good_0: You make me feel safe, @. I know I don't show it very well.$s
Entries.Good_1: I'm still learning how to be loved. Please be patient with me.$s
Entries.Good_2: I keep expecting to wake up and find out this was all a dream.$s#$e#But your hand is real. So I'll stay.
Entries.Good_3: Thank you for choosing me every day. I know I'm not easy.$s
Entries.Good_4: I like how you look at me. I just wish I knew what you see.$s
Entries.Neutral_0: I'm tired today, in my back and in my heart. I'm sorry I'm not better company.$s
Entries.Neutral_1: Do you need anything? I'm trying to be useful.$s
Entries.Bad_0: I feel like I'm disappointing you. Tell me what I'm doing wrong, please.$s
Entries.Bad_1: I'm scared we're drifting apart. I don't know how to fix it.$s
Entries.patio_Jodi: It's strange having someone else do the work. I keep feeling like I should be helping.$s
Entries.spouseRoom_Jodi: #$c .5#I'll just sit here and stretch. My back would thank you if you stopped working so hard.$h#$e#Sometimes I just need a quiet minute to remind myself I'm allowed to be here.
Entries.spring_Jodi: A new year. I want to be a better partner this time.$s
Entries.summer_Jodi: I'm trying not to wilt in this heat, or in my own doubts.$s
Entries.fall_Jodi: The leaves are falling. I always feel a little like they do this time of year.
Entries.winter_Jodi: Cold weather makes me want to hide inside. With you, though, I'd rather stay by the fire than hide.

Entries.JodiDevoted: I can't stop smiling today. Don't ask me why, you know why.$l
Entries.JodiDiamond: I keep the diamond on the dresser where I can see it when I wake up. Every time I look at it I remember that you love me.$l#$b#As if I could forget.
Entries.Rainy_Day_0: Be careful out there, my love. Come home safe and I'll have something warm waiting.$l
Entries.Rainy_Day_1: I made soup for you. I put an extra helping of love in it.$h[199 219 236 456 457]
Entries.Rainy_Day_2: My back's fussing about the rain, but I don't mind. I get to stay in and think about you.$h
Entries.Rainy_Day_3: Rainy days used to make me sad. Now they just mean cuddling later.$l
Entries.Rainy_Day_4: Sam called. I told him I've never been happier. He said he could hear it.$h
Entries.Rainy_Night_0: There you are! Come here, you're soaked. Sit by the fire and let me fuss over you.$l
Entries.Rainy_Night_1: I counted the minutes until you got home. Don't tell anyone how many.$h
Entries.Rainy_Night_2: Sit with me. I just want your shoulder to lean on. My back thanks you.$l
Entries.Rainy_Night_3: Drink this. I made it just for you. Anything for my favorite person.$l[395 253 614]
Entries.Rainy_Night_4: Rain on the roof and you beside me. I couldn't ask for anything better.$l
Entries.Indoor_Day_0: Good morning, love. I woke up before you just to watch you sleep. Don't judge me.$h
Entries.Indoor_Day_1: Pancakes for my favorite person! I made extra so you won't go hungry.$h[211]
Entries.Indoor_Day_2: I'll have the house sparkling for you tonight. You'd be amazed what love does for my energy. Not for my back, though.$h
Entries.Indoor_Day_3: I watched The Queen of Sauce and wrote down a recipe just for you.$h
Entries.Indoor_Day_4: Good morning, my dear. Today I'm trying something new in the kitchen. Please be proud of me.$h
Entries.Indoor_Night_0: Welcome home, my love. I missed you terribly.$l
Entries.Indoor_Night_1: Dinner's ready! I cooked all your favorites. Well, my favorites of yours.$h[231 198 200 205 214]
Entries.Indoor_Night_2: My back aches but my heart is full. A fair trade, I think.$h
Entries.Indoor_Night_3: Shall we call it a night? I want to fall asleep next to you.$l
Entries.Indoor_Night_4: I still can't believe you're mine. I tell myself every night, just to hear it.$l
Entries.Outdoor_0: I look at this farm and I see us. Isn't that wonderful?$h
Entries.Outdoor_1: I don't mind the sweat, or my back, as long as it's beside you.$h
Entries.Outdoor_2: Take a break, my love. I brought a snack and a very comfortable blanket.$h
Entries.Outdoor_3: I used to wish I could run away. Now all I want is to stay.$l
Entries.Outdoor_4: Every sunrise out here is a gift, and you're the best part of it.$l
Entries.Good_0: I'm so proud to be yours, @.$l
Entries.Good_1: You make me feel young again. And beautiful. Thank you.$l
Entries.Good_2: I'd marry you again tomorrow. And the day after that.$l
Entries.Good_3: My heart is yours, completely. Every ache and every wrinkle and all.$h
Entries.Good_4: I love you, @. I'll never get tired of saying it.$l
Entries.Good_7: I wrote you a love note and hid it in your pocket. Don't read it in front of anyone!$l
Entries.Good_8: I never imagined a second chance at love could feel this good.$l
Entries.Good_9: If anyone asks, I'm the happiest woman in the valley, and it's all because of you.$h
Entries.Neutral_0: I'm a little tired today, but nothing a cuddle won't fix.$h
Entries.Neutral_1: Don't worry about me. Just come home soon, okay?
Entries.Bad_0: I miss you, even when you're right here. Let's spend time together soon.$s
Entries.Bad_1: I'll always love you, even when things are hard. Please talk to me.$s
Entries.patio_Jodi: It's so nice sitting here while you work. I'll admire the view. Of the farm, of course.$h
Entries.spouseRoom_Jodi: #$c .5#I'm going to stretch and think of you. Don't let me stop you from being a hero.$l#$e#Sometimes I just sit here and remember how lucky I am.
Entries.spring_Jodi: A new year with you. I couldn't be happier.$l
Entries.summer_Jodi: Summer's here, my love. Let's have a picnic.$h
Entries.fall_Jodi: The leaves are turning. Everything is beautiful, but you're the best view.$l
Entries.winter_Jodi: Snow and a warm fire. And you. I'm the luckiest woman alive.$h
